osm_boundaries.query_rule: City = relation 2216724. Districts = admin_level=6 boundary relations that are members of that relation (not a spatial bounding-box query).

notes.text: OSM district 'Yangi Toshkent Tumani' (relation 17389398, start_date=2024, 196 km2) is a member of the Tashkent city relation but has no SIAT population row. Kept with in_siat=False.

siat_population.source: Statistics Agency under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan (SIAT)
siat_population.licence_evidence: The SIAT dataset page itself carries the footer "Manba: Oʻzbekiston Respublikasi Statistika agentligi · Litsenziya: CC BY 4.0" (Source: Statistics Agency of the Republic of Uzbekistan · Licence: CC BY 4.0), linking to https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. The parent site stat.uz states independently: "All site materials are available under license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International".
siat_population.attribution_required: Statistics Agency under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan; stat.uz asks that a link to www.stat.uz be provided when referencing its information.
siat_population.method: HTTP GET of the portal CSV download endpoint, then the CSV it points to

worldpop.release_status: alpha. The official release statement (worldpop.org, September 2025) says: "The dataset currently represents an alpha version (R2025A) public release product and may change over the coming year as improvements are made." Treat as candidate within-district spatial weights, not validated truth.
worldpop.method: HTTP GET of the WorldPop data server GeoTIFF (URL from the WorldPop REST API)
worldpop.value_meaning: estimated number of people per grid cell (persons per pixel)

osm_walk_network.method: osmnx.graph_from_bbox(network_type='walk', simplify=True) over the city bbox, then truncated to the city boundary buffered by 1000 m
osm_walk_network.query_rule: OSMnx 'walk' filter: all highways except motorways and private/no-access ways; sidewalk and footway detail retained. Buffer avoids truncating routes at the city edge.

osm_metro.method: Overpass QL union query over the city bbox (out center), clipped to the city boundary
osm_metro.query_rule: Candidates: railway in (station, halt, subway_entrance), station=subway, subway=yes, public_transport=station. Station = (station=subway OR subway=yes) AND NOT railway=subway_entrance. Entrance = railway=subway_entrance. railway=station alone is rejected so the national railway terminal is not counted as a metro station.
osm_metro.dedupe_rule: Two station objects within 200 m that share any name variant (name / name:en / name:ru) are one station. This merges the Latin+Cyrillic double-mappings that OSM carries for several Tashkent stations while keeping genuine interchanges (Oybek/Mingo'rik, Paxtakor/Alisher Navoiy, Amir Temur xiyoboni/Yunus Rajabiy, Do'stlik/Texnopark) separate. A node beats a way; a Latin name beats a Cyrillic one. Entrances within 5 m collapse regardless of name.

osm_bus_stops.method: Overpass QL union query over the city bbox (out center), clipped to the city boundary
osm_bus_stops.query_rule: Candidates: highway=bus_stop, public_transport in (platform, stop_position), bus=yes. Kept when highway=bus_stop OR (public_transport in (platform, stop_position) AND bus=yes); rail, metro and tram platforms are excluded.
osm_bus_stops.dedupe_rule: Rule A: a stop_position within 50 m of a platform sharing any name variant (25 m when unnamed) is dropped as the same physical stop. Rule B: same-role, same-name objects within 5 m collapse. Stops on opposite sides of a road are both platforms and are deliberately kept separate.

notes.text: 235 of 2163 bus stops have no name tag in OSM; they are kept because an unnamed stop is still a physical access point.

osm_bazaars.method: Overpass QL union query over the city bbox (out center), clipped to the city boundary
osm_bazaars.query_rule: amenity=marketplace only; no other tag is treated as a bazaar.
osm_bazaars.dedupe_rule: Same normalised name within 100 m collapses to one marketplace; the polygon is preferred over a node inside it.

notes.text: Bazaar coverage rests on amenity=marketplace only. Smaller informal markets are very likely missing from OSM; 83 is a lower bound, not a census.
